intro: Converting metric tons (t) to pounds (lb) is essential when translating measurements across international freight shipping, gym barbell loading, laboratory formulation, and commercial food packaging. One metric ton equals 2,204.62262 pounds, while one pound equals 0.00045359 metric tons. Whether you are verifying specifications on technical drawings, reconciling international supplier data sheets, or checking everyday measurements, this calculator applies the exact NIST and BIPM conversion factor with instant table lookups and step-by-step worked examples.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Short Ton, Long Ton, Metric Tonne & Troy vs. Avoirdupois Weight
items: In the United States, "ton" without qualification refers to the US short ton (2,000 lb = 907.18474 kg), whereas the metric tonne equals 1,000 kg (2,204.62 lb) and the UK long ton equals 2,240 lb (1,016.05 kg).
Everyday weight conversions use the Avoirdupois ounce (28.349523125 g) and pound (16 oz = 453.59237 g); precious metals like gold and silver use the heavier Troy ounce (31.1034768 g).

formula.standardNote: Verified against NIST SP 811 and BIPM SI Brochure (1 t = 2,204.62262 lb).

faqs.question: How many pounds are in 1 metric ton?
faqs.answer: There are 2,204.62262 pounds (lb) in 1 metric ton (t). To convert t to lb, use the exact conversion factor 2,204.62262.

faqs.question: How do I convert metric tons to pounds manually?
faqs.answer: Multiply your metric ton value by 2,204.62262 (exact factor: 2,204.62262). For example, 10 t × 2,204.62262 = 22,046.22622 lb.
